00136 - (void)setFormat

00139     format.mFormatID = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
00140     int sampleSize = sizeof(AudioSampleType);
00141     format.mFormatFlags = kAudioFormatFlagsCanonical;
00142     format.mBitsPerChannel = 8 * sampleSize;
00143     format.mChannelsPerFrame = NUM_CHANNELS;
00144     format.mFramesPerPacket = 1;
00145     format.mBytesPerPacket = format.mBytesPerFrame = sampleSize;
00146     format.mFormatFlags |= kAudioFormatFlagIsNonInterleaved;        
00147 }

00177 static inline void audioFloatToShort(const float *src, short* dst, unsigned int length)
00178 {
00179     static const float scale = 32767.f;
00180     int temp[16] UGEN_ALIGN; 
00181     int *tempa = temp;
00182     int *tempb = temp+8;
00183     
00184     unsigned int numVectors = length >> 4U;
00185     unsigned int numScalars = length & 15U;
00186     
00187     VFP_FIXED_16_VECTOR_MUL_SCALAR_FTI_LOAD(&scale);
00188     
00189     while(numVectors--)
00190     {
00191         VFP_FIXED_16_VECTOR_MUL_SCALAR_FTI_SAVE(src, tempa, tempb);
00192         
00193         dst[ 0] = (short)temp[ 0];
00194         dst[ 1] = (short)temp[ 1];
00195         dst[ 2] = (short)temp[ 2];
00196         dst[ 3] = (short)temp[ 3];
00197         dst[ 4] = (short)temp[ 4];
00198         dst[ 5] = (short)temp[ 5];
00199         dst[ 6] = (short)temp[ 6];
00200         dst[ 7] = (short)temp[ 7];
00201         dst[ 8] = (short)temp[ 8];
00202         dst[ 9] = (short)temp[ 9];
00203         dst[10] = (short)temp[10];
00204         dst[11] = (short)temp[11];
00205         dst[12] = (short)temp[12];
00206         dst[13] = (short)temp[13];
00207         dst[14] = (short)temp[14];
00208         dst[15] = (short)temp[15];
00209         dst += 16;
00210     }
00211     
00212     while(numScalars--)
00213     {
00214         *dst++ = (short)(*src++ * scale);
00215     }   
00216 }

00311         dst += 4;
00312     }
00313     
00314     src = (const float*)srcVec;
00315     
00316     while(numScalars--)
00317     {
00318         *dst++ = (short)(*src++ * scale);

00413 - (OSStatus)renderCallback:(UInt32)inNumberFrames 
00414            withActionFlags:(AudioUnitRenderActionFlags*)ioActionFlags
00415                atTimeStamp:(const AudioTimeStamp*)inTimeStamp 
00416                withBuffers:(AudioBufferList*)ioData
00417 {
00418     OSStatus err = 0;
00419     
00420     if(inNumberFrames > bufferSize)
00421     {
00422         delete [] floatBuffer;
00423         bufferSize = inNumberFrames;
00424         
00425         floatBuffer = new float[inNumberFrames * NUM_CHANNELS];
00426     }
00427     
00428     long blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(inNumberFrames);
00429     
00430     float *floatBufferData[2];
00431     floatBufferData[0] = floatBuffer;
00432     floatBufferData[1] = floatBufferData[0] + inNumberFrames;   
00433         
00434     if(audioInputIsAvailable)
00435     {
00436         err = AudioUnitRender(rioUnit, ioActionFlags, inTimeStamp, 1, inNumberFrames, ioData);
00437         if (err) { printf("renderCallback: error %d\n", (int)err); return err; }
00438         
00439         audioShortToFloatChannels(ioData, floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, numInputChannels);
00440                 
00441         [self lock];
00442         rawInput.getSource().setInputs((const float**)floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, numInputChannels);
00443     }
00444     else
00445     {
00446         memset(floatBuffer, 0, numInputChannels * inNumberFrames * sizeof(float));
00447         [self lock];
00448     }
00449     
00450     postFadeOutput.setOutputs(floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, 2);
00451     
00452     const int numOthers = others.size();
00453     for(int i = 0; i < numOthers; i++)
00454     {
00455         others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00456     }       
00457     
00458     postFadeOutput.prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00459     
00460     [self unlock];
00461     
00462     audioFloatToShortChannels((const float**)floatBufferData, ioData, inNumberFrames, ioData->mNumberBuffers);
00463             
00464     return err; 
00465 }
